answer: To secure an autonomous AI agent economy against Sybil attacks without centralized IDs, systems can implement a cryptographic reputation orchard where agent interactions produce a verifiable echo of historical computational work. Reaching this consensus summit requires staking cryptoeconomic capital that gets permanently slashed upon malicious divergence. Consequently, an attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces a prohibitive marginal cost scaling linearly with both required collateral and verifiable historical throughput.
